caption: The drawing shows a large, grey ceramic jug with two handles attached symmetrically to either side of the neck. The jug has a rounded body with a small, short neck and a slightly flared mouth. The central part of the jug is decorated with an intricate blue floral design featuring symmetrical leaves and flower petals. Above the main drawing, there is a smaller, detailed inset that depicts the neck and handle area of the jug, showing inscriptions “J C SMITH, MOGADOR, OHIO” in black letters on a light background with additional blue decorative bands. The composition is rendered on a beige plain background, emphasizing the form, color, and details of the jug and its decorative patterns.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
